judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

M.S. Ramesh, J.:— This petition is filed to issue suitable directions to the learned Principal District and Sessions Judge, Vellore to advance the hearing of the Bail Petition filed by the petitioners and others in Crl.M.P. No. 4323 of 2019 in Crime No. 398 of 2019 from 20.09.2019 to a date to be fixed by this Court, hear an dispose the same on merits in accordance with law.

2. On being satisfied with the reasons adduced in the petition seeking for advancement of the hearing of the Bail Application, there shall be a direction to the learned Principal District and Sessions Judge, Vellore, to advance the hearing of the Bail Petition from 20.09.2019 to 13.09.2019.

3. In view of the above, the Criminal Original Petition stands disposed of.
